name: 82301 · Rawlins, WY
findings: ZIP 82301 (Rawlins) has 31 nonprofit organizations. 18 of them (58%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 17 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 82301 (Rawlins) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
44% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 82301 (Rawlins) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 17 organizations here; 58% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 82301 (Rawlins) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 69% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 58% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
